title: Seacrest Saltwater Gospel Santa Rosa Beach, Florida 30A Vacay
meta_description: 🌴 Coastal Elegance in the Heart of Seacrest Beach | Sleeps 12 | Gulf Views + 12,000 Sq Ft Lagoon Pool! 🌊The Space🏖 Seacrest Beach Escape...
description_expanded: OverviewHot Tub Coastal Elegance in the Heart of Seacrest Beach | Sleeps 12 | Gulf Views + 12,000 Sq Ft Lagoon Pool! The Space Seacrest Beach Escape - Saltwater Gospel– Steps to Lagoon Pool & Gulf Views! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Prime Location – Steps to the 12,000 sq. ft. lagoon pool & a short stroll or tram ride to the beach (May–October) 4 Bedrooms, 4 Bathrooms – Sleeps up to 12 comfortably Gulf Views from 3rd-Floor Balcony – Sunset cocktails with a view Bright, Open-Concept Living Space – Ideal for family gatherings Fully Stocked Kitchen – Perfect for group meals & entertaining 2 Covered Patios + 3rd-Floor Outdoor Grill – Plenty of space to relax indoors & out Custom Bunk Room – Fun built-in sleeping nook for kids or groups Multiple Smart TVs – Entertainment for everyone Family-Friendly Layout – Spacious and thoughtfully designed for all ages Vibrant Seacrest Beach Community – Walkable to shops, dining, and bike paths Welcome to Your Seacrest Beach Getaway Discover the perfect beach retreat in the heart of Seacrest Beach along scenic 30A! Just steps from the community’s iconic 12,000 sq. ft. lagoon pool and a quick stroll or tram ride to the white-sand beaches of the Gulf, this 4-bedroom, 4-bath home blends comfort, style, and coastal charm. Inside, you’ll find a bright and airy open-concept living area where the fully equipped kitchen, dining space, and cozy lounge come together, making it easy for everyone to connect and relax. Whether you’re preparing a seafood feast or enjoying morning coffee, the space is designed for effortless vacation living. Each bedroom offers comfort and privacy, including two king suites with en suites, a fun custom-built bunk room for kids or teens, and a queen bedroom with its own bath. Head up to the 3rd floor for Gulf views, a built-in outdoor grill, and the perfect spot to watch the sunset. With multiple patios and plenty of indoor and outdoor living areas, this home is ideal for families or groups of friends looking to soak up everything Seacrest Beach has to offer. Explore local dining, bike the scenic trails, and enjoy the laid-back 30A lifestyle. ** Please note the pool will be closed for resurfacing starting October 27th, 2025 through November 24th, 2025. We apologize for any inconvenience. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (12): 1st Floor Primary Suite – King bed, walk-in closet, flat-screen TV, en suite bathroom 1st Floor Guest Room – King bed, walk-in closet, flat-screen TV, full bathroom 2nd Floor Custom Bunk Room – 4 built-in twin beds + twin trundle, flat-screen TV, full bath 3rd Floor Guest Bedroom – Queen bed, flat-screen TV, full bathroom AREA ATTRACTIONS: The Seacrest Beach community is a favorite along 30A, offering easy access to the beach, a massive resort-style lagoon pool, and charming nearby towns like Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach. Stroll or bike to local shops, grab fresh seafood at George’s or LaCo, and cool off with treats from the Sweet Peddler. Spend your days lounging by the pool, biking scenic trails, or exploring 30A’s pristine beaches. Your Seacrest Beach escape is ready to welcome you!Show less
